critical_code_review_comments: app/_layout.tsx PUBLIC_SEGMENTS correctly whitelists 'decider-store' so the public storefront + detail render without triggering the auth guard's redirect to /auth/login.

decider-store/[id].tsx correctly stashes 'pending_decider_clone' before /auth/login redirect; postAuthRedirect.ts consumes it and returns '/decider-store/<id>?use=<mode>' so the detail screen's useEffect can auto-fire doClone() when isAuthenticated becomes true. The `resumed.current` ref prevents double-cloning on re-renders.

admin/decider-store.tsx Classify modal exposes the full contract: Mandatory/Optional segmented (segMand/segOpt) + priority stepper + Quant/Qual type toggle (typeQuant/typeQual) with the correct downstream labels 'Solution Store' / 'ReviewNet'. Save routes through PUT /api/decider-store/<id> with the mutated factors array — persistence verified via API.
